pairs.subject: guided-tours
pairs.evidence: src/contexts/TourContext.tsx:170 Most steps advance because the narration clip ended or the dwell timer fired, so the tour moves while the visitor watches unless that step sets waitForSignal.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/tour-progress.ts:65 Board, mission, and health declare advanceOn but not waitForSignal and have no audioSrc, so dwellMs still completes them; only the reviews step waits for the real signal.

src/lib/tour-anchors.test.ts:248 The test derives selectors from the live step objects and fails when src/ does not host that attribute; the spotlight re-queries the selector every animation frame rather than caching the element.
src/components/tour/TourSpotlight.tsx:37 Every unresolved step takes this one path after 3000ms; TourStep has no per-step skip or re-center field, and the breadcrumb records only waitedMs.
src/hooks/useTourAudio.ts:170 A step clip's ended event schedules advancement, and an audio error does the same after dwellMs; captions do exist as text and playback is paused on cleanup.

src/components/tour/TourCaptionCard.tsx:45 Tab is trapped in the caption on every step, including steps that ask the visitor to use the spotlit control; the tour paints at z-[80]/z-[90] and Escape always exits it.
src/hooks/useTourAutostart.ts:7 Step ids are stable strings, but stepIndex is React state, start() begins at 0, and the only stored tour flag means started, not resumed, completed, or declined.
